density_profile: Edge-dense occupied cavern settlements; three clustered overhead work islands; wide intentionally vacant central flight and low-basin volume

route_grammar.alternative: West inhabited cave → low dry crater → twin rescue shafts → east cliff (explicit reconnect to upper air route)

procedural_exemplar_value: Shows a crater-spanning multi-altitude structure made from dissimilar suspended modules with rooted diagonal load paths, split cable skyline, asymmetric settlement orientation, explicit long-range branch/rejoin flight lanes and a sparse editable center; suitable as examples for SWARM connector negotiation and GENTEK structural grammars.
similarity_avoidance: Unlike Sable Quoin's central five-arm collimator and opposing stacked cave laboratories, this world uses three separated rafts, a disjoint tensile harp and a sloping V-basin with twin inhabitable cave mouths; unlike the Underroot Relay nested-cavity archive, its dominant playable mass is exterior open air.
authoring_note: Classification describes committed final material cells; no generator/engine behavior is inferred from it.
